paite: Huan Jobin a dawnga, hichiin a chi a:
Thilhihtheihna neilou amah bangchiin na panpihta a amai; hanta neilou ban bangchiin na hondamta a amai;
english: “How have you helped him who is without power! How have you saved the arm that has no strength!

paite: Pilna neilou amah bangchin na thuhilha, huan nakpitaka theihna hoih na phuangkheta a;
english: How have you counseled him who has no wisdom, and plentifully declared sound knowledge!

paite: Kua kiangah ahia thute na genkhiak tak? Huan kua kha ahia nang akipan hongpai khia?
english: To whom have you uttered words? Whose spirit came forth from you?

paite: Sisate tuite nuai leh huaia tengte nuaiah a ling uh.
english: “Those who are deceased tremble, those beneath the waters and all that live in them.

paite: A maah Seol vuaktangin a oma, huan Abaddon in kikhuhna a neikei hi.
english: Sheol Sheol is the lower world or the grave. is naked before God, and Abaddon Abaddon means Destroyer. has no covering.

paite: Aman mal mun awng tungah a phalh khia a, huan bang mahlou tungah lei a khai hi.
english: He stretches out the north over empty space, and hangs the earth on nothing.

paite: A meipi sahin tuite a tuna; huan huaite nuaiah meipi a kikek kei hi.
english: He binds up the waters in his thick clouds, and the cloud is not burst under them.

paite: Khapi mai a khuha, a tungah a meipi a phalh hi.
english: He encloses the face of his throne, and spreads his cloud on it.

paite: Tuite tungah, khovak leh khomial kigitna ah, kawlmong a kaikual hi.
english: He has described a boundary on the surface of the waters, and to the confines of light and darkness.

paite: A salhna ah van khuamte a ling ua, lamdang a sa uh.
english: The pillars of heaven tremble and are astonished at his rebuke.

paite: A thilhihtheihnain tuipi a khawlsaka, huan a theihsiamna in Rahab a sat.
english: He stirs up the sea with his power, and by his understanding he strikes through Rahab.

paite: A huin vante bawlhoihin a oma; a khutin gulpi man-gang tailai a sun hi.Ngaiin, hiaite a thilhih mong lel ahi uh. Ngatchika a huau siausiau lel! A thilhihtheihna Vanging kua ahia theisiam ding?
english: By his Spirit the heavens are garnished. His hand has pierced the swift serpent.

paite: Ngaiin, hiaite a thilhih mong lel ahi uh. Ngatchika a huau siausiau lel! A thilhihtheihna Vanging kua ahia theisiam ding?
english: Behold, these are but the outskirts of his ways. How small a whisper do we hear of him! But the thunder of his power who can understand?”
